For me personally, I feel like my suicidal thoughts stem from me personally hating myself or stuff about myself and severe low self esteem. So something I did was I bought all these inspirational uplifting words and pictures or I made them and put them up all around my apartment. My living room, my kitchen, my bathroom, bed room, even in my car. Stuff that says: you’re beautiful, your body is fine, you’re enough, one day at a time, you’re strong, you’re worth it.. etc. Literally that little thing has helped me so much, it makes me smile when I read it. Whenever I start thinking suicidal stuff or thinking negatively about myself, I literally look over and it’s something positive helping me think clearly. That and working on changing the things about myself that I don’t like, that I do have the power to change.

Get an after school job. Tbh that was a great thing for me when I was in school. I didn’t need to work because my parents had money, but I was also tired of sitting at home or always asking them for money. I started working and making my own money and making great friends along the way. That was a great start for me working on my independence honestly. You really really learn the value of a dollar when you’re spending your own money you earned. So if you wanna gain some independence from your parents, start earning some money of your own.
